cascade_calibration.selection_rule: Maximize accepted dev cases subject to precision/minimum support; ties prefer precision, higher similarity, then larger margin. No eligible gate disables embedding acceptance.

limitations: Self-authored bounded tool benchmark, not Terminal-Bench or arbitrary Bash end-to-end accuracy.
Two different model families; parameter count does not establish stronger capability or lower cost.
Local token/compute/time measures are resource proxies, not API charges or measured electricity cost.
Few independent heldout cases; descriptive intervals are exploratory.
End-to-end duration includes model loads, routing and fallback; provider load is also reported separately.
Misrouting labels use separate fixed-model observations and cannot prove a counterfactual under model variability.
No human judge, online gray release, production feedback, or learned router training is established.
Cascade thresholds are fit on few development leave-one-out predictions, not calibrated probabilities. The existing heldout benchmark is a previously inspected regression set, not a fresh blind test.

selection.selection_rule: Development records only; missing/incomplete attempts remain unsuccessful in the shared case denominator. Reference maximizes overall success; each family maximizes success and prefers the economical model on ties. Remaining ties use lexical model IDs; model size never determines capability. Economical model minimizes development mean provider_compute_ms with complete case/metric coverage; this timing proxy is not an API-price estimate.

same_request_variability.interpretation: Identical submitted payload hashes across actual solver calls; observed outcome variability, not an independent controlled repeat experiment.

budget.token_limit_kind: returned_usage_stop; missing usage cannot prove a hard token cap

cascade_calibration.selection_rule: Maximize accepted dev cases subject to precision/minimum support; ties prefer precision, higher similarity, then larger margin. No eligible gate disables embedding acceptance.

limitations: Self-authored bounded tool benchmark, not Terminal-Bench or arbitrary Bash end-to-end accuracy.
Two different model families; parameter count does not establish stronger capability or lower cost.
Local token/compute/time measures are resource proxies, not API charges or measured electricity cost.
Few independent heldout cases; descriptive intervals are exploratory.
End-to-end duration includes model loads, routing and fallback; provider load is also reported separately.
Misrouting labels use separate fixed-model observations and cannot prove a counterfactual under model variability.
No human judge, online gray release, production feedback, or learned router training is established.
Cascade thresholds are fit on few development leave-one-out predictions, not calibrated probabilities. The existing heldout benchmark is a previously inspected regression set, not a fresh blind test.

selection.selection_rule: Development records only; missing/incomplete attempts remain unsuccessful in the shared case denominator. Reference maximizes overall success; each family maximizes success and prefers the economical model on ties. Remaining ties use lexical model IDs; model size never determines capability. Economical model minimizes development mean provider_compute_ms with complete case/metric coverage; this timing proxy is not an API-price estimate.

same_request_variability.interpretation: Identical submitted payload hashes across actual solver calls; observed outcome variability, not an independent controlled repeat experiment.

limitations: 仅汇总 heldout；dev 仅用于冻结选择规则，不进入报告成绩。
未启动及不完整任务保留在计划成功率分母中，且不计为成功。
延迟分位数仅使用已启动且有测量值的任务；缺失值不按零处理。
配对 bootstrap 以 case 为独立单位，先平均同一 case 的匹配重复；小样本仅作探索。
固定模型对照仅识别可观察的路由机会，不预测某次路由调用的真实反事实结果；模型输出存在波动。
请求、token 和 provider compute 是观测资源代理；未测量实际 API 费用、显存、能耗或占用成本。
不完整证据可能遗漏已发生的请求；已保存请求数和已知部分 token 不等于完整总量。
固定模型对照仅识别可观察的路由机会，不预测某次路由调用的真实反事实结果；模型输出存在波动。
请求、token 和 provider compute 是观测资源代理；未测量实际 API 费用、显存、能耗或占用成本。
avoidable_escalation 仅在固定调用的 compute 与输入/输出 token 均完整且资源代理满足 Pareto 支配时标记。
